meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the LBA Capital Projects Fund Budget for Fiscal Year 2022-23 and refer the item to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Local Building Authority Capital Projects Fund budget for FY2022-23, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA session and transition the meeting body to the Redevelopment Agency.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the RDA Budget for Fiscal Year 2022-23 and refer the item to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Redevelopment Agency's final budget for FY2022-23 and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Redevelopment Agency and reconvene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the RDA session and transition the meeting body to the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Approve the Work Session minutes from September 14, 2021 and the Formal Meeting Minutes from May 3, 2022.
votes.description: Approves two sets of prior meeting minutes: the work session from September 14, 2021 and the formal meeting from May 3, 2022.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on FY2022-23 budget-related ordinances (G1–G10) and refer the items to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing on ten ordinances implementing the Mayor's Recommended Budget for FY2022-23, including tax levy, Library Fund, fee schedule, MOU appropriations, and compensation plans, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 29 of 2022: Zoning Map Amendment at Western Gardens, 550 South 600 East, rezoning from CN to FB-UN2.
votes.description: Approves a zoning map amendment for the Western Gardens commercial center at 550 S 600 E, changing the zoning from Neighborhood Commercial (CN) to Form Based Urban Neighborhood (FB-UN2) to facilitate redevelopment into a multifamily residential project.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 30 of 2022 approving the Salt Lake City Reimagine Nature Master Plan, subject to a revision requiring any referenced friends group or 501(c)(3) supporting City parks to be separate from the City, not managed by City employees, and have a contractual, transparent relationship with the City.
votes.description: Adopts the City's twenty-year Public Lands Master Plan 'Reimagine Nature,' establishing a long-range vision for parks, natural lands, and urban forests, with an added condition governing the structure and transparency of any nonprofit partners involved in park support or maintenance.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 31 of 2022 approving a $150,000 loan for Buddies, Inc. from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: Approves a $150,000 Economic Development Revolving Loan Fund loan to Buddies, Inc. at 1150 East 600 South, which will own and operate concessions and rides at Liberty Park.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda except for item 3, board appointment of Janis Bennion.
votes.description: Approves all consent agenda items — including setting CIP public hearing dates, and board appointments/reappointments for Lisia Satini (Racial Equity in Policing Commission), Thomas Kessinger (Arts Council), Siavash Ghaffari (Sugar House Park Authority), Daniel Mendoza (Transportation Advisory Board), and Suzanne Stensaas (Transportation Advisory Board) — while excluding the appointment of Janis Bennion to the Housing Authority.
